purpose: Promote the fixed word bank at 0x00006744 after recovering its static scene-resource actor-coordinate consumer.
evidence: The menu continuation writes ROM address 0x00006744 into SCENE_RESOURCE_ACTOR_RECORD_CURSOR at 0x001B3D68.
SceneResource_InstantiateQueuedActor reads the cursor's first two words as X/Y coordinates, allocates and initializes the queued Type-0x84 actor, then publishes A0 advanced by four bytes on success.

The exact ROM range contains 62 nonzero X/Y pairs followed only by a final zero X-word sentinel, matching the helper's zero-X termination test and the established boundary before TERRAIN_ACTOR_SURFACE_FLAGS_TABLE.
reachability: The static consumer is in a Ghidra-unreachable physical menu continuation, so this establishes static ownership and use but not live runtime reachability.
